notCaptured.item: layer tree drag states (dragged row at 30% opacity, 2 px drop line, child drop outline)
notCaptured.reason: row drag is native HTML5 drag and drop; headless Chrome starts the drag (drag interception reports a payload) but the app never enters its dragging state when the protocol replays enter/over events, so no indicator is drawn. Values stay source-derived (theme/layer-tree.ts).

notCaptured.item: switch mixed state and md size
notCaptured.reason: mixed is only used for boolean component properties of an instance (needs a component with a boolean property); no screen uses the md size.

notCaptured.item: disabled icon buttons and number fields
notCaptured.reason: no screen of the default build disables them; disabled appears only on menu items, accent buttons in the share popover and the page delete item (all captured).

notCaptured.reason: only the switch focus ring was driven through the keyboard (Tab).
